name: 陳雅玫
objective: This course equips English majors to design and critically evaluate AI-supported language-learning experiences. Using microlearning—short, focused learning experiences organized around a single measurable objective—as a common design framework, students develop the pedagogical, technological, and evaluative competencies needed to use generative AI responsibly and effectively in language education. Throughout the course, students apply principles of AI literacy, microlearning design, learner-centered pedagogy, instructional design, and teacher professional development to create AI-supported learning tools and materials. They gain experience with prompt-based learning activities, educational assistants, chatbots, AI agents, and feedback-oriented applications across platforms such as Mizou, Edcafe AI, Claude Skills, Dify, Coze, and Opal. By comparing and testing these tools, students learn to evaluate their pedagogical value, usability, reliability, adaptability, and appropriateness for specific learning objectives and contexts.

Microlearning with GenAI
延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
